It emerged after the consolidation of the branded apparel businesses of [[Aditya Birla Group|Aditya Birla Nuvo Limited]] (ABNL), comprising ABNL's Madura Fashion division and ABNL's subsidiaries Pantaloons Fashion and Retail (PFRL) and Madura Fashion & Lifestyle (MFL), in May 2015. Post consolidation, PFRL was renamed Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd.{{cite news |title=Pantaloons changes its name to Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/retail/pantaloons-changes-its-name-to-aditya-birla-fashion-and-retail/articleshow/50552231.cms |access-date=23 October 2020 |work=The Economic Times |archive-date=13 March 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220313155112/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/retail/pantaloons-changes-its-name-to-aditya-birla-fashion-and-retail/articleshow/50552231.cms |url-status=live }} ==History== [[File:Pantaloons, Kankurgachi, Kolkata - panoramio.jpg|thumb|A Pantaloons store in [[Kolkata]].]] Madura Garments was established in 1988, acquired by the Aditya Birla Group in 1999 and was renamed Madura Fashion & Lifestyle in 2010.{{cite news |last1=Agarwal |first1=P. R. Sanjai, Sapna |title=Aditya Birla Group to merge apparel business units |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/Tkmkh24tHNUfX21ngDTgTP/Aditya-Birla-Group-to-merge-Madura-Garments-with-Pantaloon-R.html |work=mint |date=3 May 2015 |language=en |archive-date=5 December 2020 |access-date=4 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201205185345/https://www.livemint.com/Companies/Tkmkh24tHNUfX21ngDTgTP/Aditya-Birla-Group-to-merge-Madura-Garments-with-Pantaloon-R.html |url-status=live }}{{cite web |title=Aditya Birla's Madura Fashion and Lifestyle business to move to a 12-season cycle |url=https://in.fashionnetwork.com/news/Aditya-birla-s-madura-fashion-and-lifestyle-business-to-move-to-a-12-season-cycle,1127178.html |website=FashionNetwork.com |language=en-IN}} The garment activities of group holding company Aditya Birla Nuvo and another group entity, Madura Garments Lifestyle Retail, would be demerged into listed firm Pantaloons Fashion & Retail Ltd (PFRL) under the scheme of arrangement. Madura owns and retails brands such as Louis Philippe, Van Heusen, Allen Solly, Peter England. In 2012, Aditya Birla Nuvo acquired major stakes in Pantaloons. In 2015, Pantaloons was renamed Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd. (ABFRL).{{cite web |title=Aditya Birla Nuvo acquires major stake in Pantaloons – The Textile Magazine |url=https://www.indiantextilemagazine.in/aditya-birla-nuvo-acquires-major-stake-in-pantaloons/ |website=Indiantextilemagazine.|date=24 May 2012 }} ABFRL acquired the Jaypore brand and bought 51% stake in Finesse International Design that runs the designer wear label Shantanu & Nikhil in 2019.{{cite web|url=https://www.livemint.com/industry/retail/aditya-birla-fashion-and-retail-set-to-expand-jaypore-shantanu-nikhil-brand-1565410899228.html|title=Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail set to expand Jaypore, Shantanu & Nikhil brand|website=Livemint|date=10 August 2019|access-date=1 March 2022|archive-date=1 March 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220301095046/https://www.livemint.com/industry/retail/aditya-birla-fashion-and-retail-set-to-expand-jaypore-shantanu-nikhil-brand-1565410899228.html|url-status=live}} In 2020, [[Flipkart]] acquired a 7.8% stake in ABFRL for {{INR}} 1,500 crore.{{cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/funding/flipkart-to-invest-rs-1500-crore-in-aditya-birla-fashion-retail/articleshow/78822695.cms|title=Flipkart to invest Rs 1,500 crore in Aditya Birla Fashion & Retail|website=The Economic Times|date=23 October 2020|access-date=1 March 2022|archive-date=1 March 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220301095040/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/funding/flipkart-to-invest-rs-1500-crore-in-aditya-birla-fashion-retail/articleshow/78822695.cms|url-status=live}} In 2021, ABFRL entered into an agreement to buy a 51% stake in the designer brand Sabyasachi. Later that year, ABFRL entered into a partnership with designer [[Tarun Tahiliani]]. ABFRL also partnered with [[Authentic Brands]] Group to take on Reebok's operations in India.{{cite web |date=16 February 2022 |title=ABFRL planning portfolio of up to 30 internet first brands |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/abfrl-expects-10-15-of-revenue-from-online-first-brands-in-5-years-11644924927973.html |access-date=1 March 2022 |website=The Economic Times}} In January 2022, ABFRL acquired 51% stake in House of Masaba Lifestyle.{{cite web |date=4 February 2022 |title=Birla has the best wedding suits stacked up and he wants them displayed on your phone |url=https://www.businessinsider.in/business/ecommerce/news/aditya-birla-fashion-retail-d2c-unit-will-sell-ethnic-and-wedding-wear-from-top-designers/articleshow/89347587.cms |access-date=1 March 2022 |website=Business Insider |archive-date=17 March 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220317053204/https://www.businessinsider.in/business/ecommerce/news/aditya-birla-fashion-retail-d2c-unit-will-sell-ethnic-and-wedding-wear-from-top-designers/articleshow/89347587.cms |url-status=dead }} In December 2021, ABFRL experienced a [[data breach]] carried out by [[ShinyHunters]], whose ransom demand was allegedly rejected. Subsequently, customer information including 5.4 million unique email addresses, names, phone numbers, physical addresses, order histories and passwords stored as MD5 hashes was dumped publicly on a hacking forum.{{Cite news|url = https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/fashion-/-cosmetics-/-jewellery/abfrl-faces-data-breach-on-its-portal/articleshow/88930807.cms|title = Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail faces data breach on its portal|newspaper = The Economic Times|archive-date = 27 January 2022|access-date = 28 January 2022|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20220127124124/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/fashion-/-cosmetics-/-jewellery/abfrl-faces-data-breach-on-its-portal/articleshow/88930807.cms|url-status = live}}{{Cite web|url=https://gadgets.ndtv.com/internet/news/aditya-birla-fashion-retail-abfrl-data-leak-breach-vulnerable-hacker-shinyhunters-2715489|title=Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Sites Said to Still be Vulnerable; Company Says 'Access Secured'|date=18 January 2022|access-date=28 January 2022|archive-date=26 January 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220126200757/https://gadgets.ndtv.com/internet/news/aditya-birla-fashion-retail-abfrl-data-leak-breach-vulnerable-hacker-shinyhunters-2715489|url-status=live}} In April 2024, ABFRL's subsidiary Madura Fashion & Lifestyle demerged into a separate public listed entity.{{cite web |title=Aditya Birla Fashion to demerge Madura business into separate listed entity, plans to raise funds after process |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/business/aditya-birla-fashion-to-demerge-madura-business-into-separate-listed-entity-plans-to-raise-funds-after-process-101711988175782.html |website=The Hindustan Times |language=en |date=1 April 2024 |access-date=29 April 2024 |archive-date=29 April 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240429181408/https://www.hindustantimes.com/business/aditya-birla-fashion-to-demerge-madura-business-into-separate-listed-entity-plans-to-raise-funds-after-process-101711988175782.html |url-status=live }} In May 2024, ABFRL acquired an additional stake in its subsidiary Indivinity Clothing Retail Private Limited (ICRPL) which increased ABFRL's holding from 80% to 85.54%.{{cite web |title=Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Strengthens Grip on Ethnic Wear Brand Tasva |url=https://www.brutimes.com/news/business/aditya-birla-fashion-and-retail-strengthens-grip-on-ethnic-wear-brand-tasva |website=Bru Times News |language=en}} In 2024, Aditya Birla Group took a decision to demerge ABFRL's erstwhile Madura business into Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited (ABLBL), This demerger was effective on 1st May 2025.{{cite web |last1=Sethi |first1=Vaamanaa |title=ABFRL Demerger: Is Aditya Birla Fashion share price really 66% down as the spin-off kicks in? extract: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited (ABFRL) is an Indian fashion retail company headquartered in Mumbai. It emerged after the consolidation of the branded apparel businesses of Aditya Birla Nuvo Limited (ABNL), comprising ABNL's Madura Fashion division and ABNL's subsidiaries Pantaloons Fashion and Retail (PFRL) and Madura Fashion & Lifestyle (MFL), in May 2015. Post consolidation, PFRL was renamed Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd.
